notes: The Rotting Hull. Built on hull_template (title_template2 with Soft Cello on 'flute' (insert 1), Emulator II Clarinet on 'choir_pad' (insert 4, PITCH -17 as in the shop), a second 12 Low Strings on 'bell_tower' (insert 5) for the bowed bass, Rom2A 30-BLOCK on 'bell_marrow' (insert 7) for the hull's creaks, the frame-drum sampler moved to insert 3 (sub_breath) for the deep drum (key 36 plays the sample at 50). Both 12 Low Strings parts +12: the preset sounds an octave low. Review v5 (FAIL): drum on D2 (key 36 plays 53) at -35 with a 70 Hz cut and empty downbeats; strings sway by voices (the preset ignores velocity); B cello holds one bar at a time under the clarinet (-26.5); the block plays two octaves down on irregular eighths behind a 1.5 kHz cut; clarinet PITCH -7 (D3-F4 read -10.6 c at -17).
